text: Relvato for DeepSeek Harness 是 DSH 插件，通过内置 MCP 客户端连接 Relvato 托管服务。它将网站监控工具提供给 DSH agent，连接使用 streamable HTTP。设置 RELVATO_API_KEY 后，客户端会发送 Bearer 授权头；没有密钥时仍能列出工具，但调用需要密钥。适合想让 agent 访问 Relvato 网站监控服务的用户。

Relvato for DeepSeek Harness connects DSH’s built-in MCP client to Relvato’s hosted website monitoring service. It uses streamable HTTP and sends RELVATO_API_KEY as a Bearer header when configured. Tools can be listed without a key, but calls require one.
想让 DSH agent 通过 MCP 查询网站监控状况。
能不能在 DSH 里连接 Relvato 来运行站点监控？
I want my DSH agent to access a hosted website monitoring service over MCP.
Relvato for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「连接 MCP」：插件配置 DSH 通过 streamable HTTP 连接 Relvato，并在设置 RELVATO_API_KEY 时附带 Bearer 授权头。
Relvato for DeepSeek Harness 使用前须知：工具请求发往 app.relvato.com；设置 RELVATO_API_KEY 后，该密钥随授权头发送。（见 cordis.patch.yml:10-11）

Relvato for DeepSeek Harness

Website monitoring your DeepSeek Harness agent can run.
Developer docs · MCP server · relvato.com

---

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Introduction：[Relvato](https://www.relvato.com) monitors websites in a real browser: sign-ups, logins, checkout, page speed, search
visibility and security. It runs those monitors on a schedule and again whenever the site changes, works on any
website, and goes deepest on WordPress and WooCommerce.

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Introduction：This is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **bundle**. It adds Relvato's hosted MCP
server (58 tools) to your profile through dsh's in-box MCP client. It is configuration only: no code from this package
runs in dsh, and there is no build step.

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Introduction：With it, your agent can add a site and set up its monitors, run them, read health, uptime, Core Web Vitals and each
run's findings, explain a failure with Relvato's fix brief, review results (with undo) and, on WordPress, apply the one
fix a run proposes, with automatic rollback.

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Install：1. Create a Relvato API key at [app.relvato.com/api-access](https://app.relvato.com/api-access) (there's a free plan).
   **Full access** lets the agent set up and run monitors; **read-only** only lets it read.
2. Make the key available to dsh as `RELVATO_API_KEY`: in your shell environment, or in `$DSH_HOME/.env`
   (default `~/.dsh/.env`):

```sh
   RELVATO_API_KEY=rlv_your_key
   ```

Keep it out of files you commit.
3. Add the bundle to a profile:

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Install：```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-relvato
   ```

It's on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-relvato) (and its mirrors, such as npmmirror). To install
   straight from GitHub instead: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Relvato/dsh-plugin-relvato`. You can also add it
   from the **Plugins** page in the dsh Web UI.

4. Restart dsh (or let HMR reload it). Relvato's tools appear as `mcp__relvato__<tool>`, for example
   `mcp__relvato__list_sites`.

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Install：Check that the layer is there without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-plugin-relvato" layer with the relvato MCP client
```

To remove it: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-relvato`.

dsh-plugin-relvato README · What it adds：One row, `relvato`, for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` ([cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)):

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `serverName` | `relvato` |
| `transport` | `streamable-http` |
| `url` | `https://app.relvato.com/api/mcp` |
| `headers` | `Authorization: Bearer $RELVATO_API_KEY`, only when the variable is set |

dsh-plugin-relvato README · What it adds：Without `RELVATO_API_KEY`, dsh still connects and lists Relvato's tools, but every call is refused until you add a key.
To change a setting, override the `relvato` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, restating every key it needs.

dsh's MCP client sends headers and doesn't support OAuth sign-in, so this bundle uses an API key. In clients that do
(Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code), you can sign in instead: see [Relvato/relvato-mcp](https://github.com/Relvato/relvato-mcp).

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Things to ask：- "Set up monitoring for example.com and tell me what I need to do to connect it."
- "Run all the monitors on my site and tell me what broke." (A full run takes several minutes; the agent is told how long.)
- "Why did checkout fail on my shop last night, and how do I fix it?"
- "How fast is my site for real visitors, and what's slowing it down?"

dsh-plugin-relvato README · Things to ask：The agent works under the same rules as the dashboard: it can't skip proving you own a site, approve file-integrity,
script or DNS changes, change who receives alerts, delete anything, or see secrets. Tools that change your site are
marked destructive.
